knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：库存周转；延伸至积压、低库存、滞销和库存金额
knowledgePoints.concept: 2025年：净销售出库成本含退货冲回；年初价值以2024-12-31快照、年末以2025-12-31快照；平均库存=两端均值；周转天数365/周转率，销售成本非正时天数NULL。 缺失任一商品的期初或期末快照时，该仓库类别的平均库存及周转指标返回NULL，不将缺失当作零。

teaching.problem: 仓库经理需要区分库存价值和期间流量，才能解释哪些类别周转缓慢。
teaching.codeExplanation: 将出库及退货按仓库类别聚合，单独汇总期初与期末快照。以两期平均库存价值为周转率分母，周转天数以期间天数除周转率。
teaching.resultExplanation: 零库存分母得到 NULL。低周转可结合分类库存余额再查积压，但高价值库存未必是积压。

checkpoints.label: 按仓库类别汇总出库成本
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT warehouse_id,p.category_id,SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='sale' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents WHEN movement_type='return' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents ELSE 0 END) cogs FROM stock_movements m JOIN products p ON p.product_id=m.product_id WHERE movement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,p.category_id)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;

checkpoints.label: 期初期末库存价值取平均
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT warehouse_id,p.category_id,SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='sale' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents WHEN movement_type='return' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents ELSE 0 END) cogs FROM stock_movements m JOIN products p ON p.product_id=m.product_id WHERE movement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,p.category_id), b AS (SELECT w.warehouse_id,c.category_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(i.snapshot_id)=2*COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) THEN SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents)/2.0 ELSE NULL END avg_stock FROM warehouses w CROSS JOIN categories c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id=c.category_id LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id AND i.product_id=p.product_id AND i.snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY w.warehouse_id,c.category_id)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;

mergedConcepts.explanation: 先保存每个商品的快照数量及同一成本口径，再累加数量×单位成本得到仓库类别价值。售价和采购成本量纲虽都是金额，不能把售价乘数量后当库存成本。
2025 年以 2024-12-31 和 2025-12-31 两端快照均值作分母，出库成本需冲回退货。缺失必要快照时不算周转率；销售成本非正时周转天数留空，正常情况下用 365 除以周转率。

knowledgePoints.title: 电商：复购率和客户粒度
knowledgePoints.concept: 在指定期间按有效订单统计每客户购买次数，复购客户至少2次；分母为至少购买一次的客户。
knowledgePoints.syntax:
WITH purchases AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) purchase_count
  FROM customers c JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND o.net_cents>0
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS purchasing_customers,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_count>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS repeat_customers,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_count>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS repeat_pct
FROM purchases

knowledgePoints.useCase: 电商运营需要评估2025年发生有效购买的客户是否再次购买。
knowledgePoints.comparison: v_order_net已将订单明细汇总，并在明细层预先汇总多次退款，避免连接后重复计数。先筛选2025年线上正净额订单，再按客户计不同订单数。第二层汇总把粒度从客户改为全体购买客户，条件计数得到至少两次购买的人数。没有购买客户时两个计数均为0，复购率为NULL。

commonError.example: 改变指标条件、总体分母、相邻月份方向或前三名数量。

knowledgePoints.notes: 示例采用可逐笔核对的小型数据，练习采用正式业务数据库。金额单位为马币分。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

knowledgePoints.setupSql:
CREATE VIEW v_sales_lines AS SELECT i.order_item_id,o.order_id,o.store_id,o.customer_id,o.session_id,o.channel,o.order_date,i.product_id,i.promotion_id,i.quantity-COALESCE(r.qty,0) AS net_qty,i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents-COALESCE(r.refund,0) AS net_cents,(i.quantity-COALESCE(r.qty,0))*i.unit_cost_cents AS cost_cents,i.discount_cents,COALESCE(r.refund,0) AS refund_cents FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id,SUM(quantity) qty,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM returns WHERE return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id=i.order_item_id WHERE o.status='completed';
CREATE VIEW v_order_net AS SELECT order_id,store_id,customer_id,session_id,channel,order_date,SUM(net_cents) net_cents,SUM(cost_cents) cost_cents FROM v_sales_lines GROUP BY order_id,store_id,customer_id,session_id,channel,order_date;

teaching.resultExplanation: 分母是有效购买客户人数，分子是至少两次有效购买的人数。可按不同客户群分层比较，分母为空时保留 NULL。

teaching.problem: 仓储经理需要知道哪个仓的商品卖得慢却占资多。
teaching.codeExplanation: 将期末库存与最近期间的销售量分别聚合到仓库和商品粒度，再计算覆盖天数。把零销量、低库存和滞销区分开，以免把无法计算天数当成无风险。
teaching.resultExplanation: 高库存与极长覆盖天数提示积压。结合是否近期补货或有有效需求来决定后续处理。

checkpoints.name: s
checkpoints.label: 按仓库商品汇总期间出库量
checkpoints.sql:
WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-10-03' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id)
SELECT * FROM s ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;

mergedConcepts.explanation: 高库存阈值适合第一轮圈选。复查时结合安全库存和周转速度，避免把为节庆准备的库存直接认定为积压。
低库存监控用同一天、同一仓库的快照数量与该商品补货阈值比较；多个仓库可调拨时再看可用库存。不能把统一数量线当成所有商品的安全库存。
确认来源覆盖完整后，近一段时间没有销售出库且期末仍有库存，可单列为滞销候选。此时以销量为分母的覆盖天数不可定义，应保留零销量标签而不是删除这批商品。
同一分析可设双向规则：近 30 日毛销量至少 30 且可用量不足 15 日需求，标为畅销缺货风险；销量不超过 3 且成本价值至少 300000 分，标为积压。两类业务判断应分别核对销量方向、库存价值和商品有效性。

knowledgePoints.concept: 2025年有线上有效购买的客户；截止12-31距最近购买天数；年度订单数和净消费金额；分别按最近日期近到远、频率高到低、金额高到低分五组（并列客户编号）；三个分数5为最好；总分≥13为高价值、≤6为低活跃。

parameters.金额: 整数马币分；比率按题设

knowledgePoints.title: 首购月份留存矩阵
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 在统一企业数据库中独立完成：首购月份留存矩阵
knowledgePoints.concept: 线上有效订单；首次购买月为同期群，观察第0至第6月；按首购月与月偏移输出同期群规模、活跃客户与留存率；没有活跃但已观察的月份为0，未来月份不输出。

knowledgePoints.title: 预算与实际费用差异
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 在统一企业数据库中独立完成：预算与实际费用差异
knowledgePoints.concept: 2025年部门×费用科目，预算与费用分录各自汇总，偏差=实际-预算；超过预算10%标记；保留有预算但没有发生额的项目；分母为零返回NULL。
knowledgePoints.syntax: WITH b AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(budget_cents) budget FROM budgets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY department_id,account_id), a AS (SELECT department_id,account_id,SUM(expense_cents) actual FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY department_id,account_id) SELECT b.department_id,b.account_id,b.budget budget_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0) actual_cents,COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget variance_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.actual,0)-b.budget)/NULLIF(b.budget,0),2) variance_pct,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.actual,0)>b.budget*1.1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END over_budget FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.department_id=b.department_id AND a.account_id=b.account_id ORDER BY b.department_id,b.account_id

teaching.problem: 财务需要在年度预算覆盖的部门科目内检查超支。
teaching.codeExplanation: 分别按部门科目汇总预算与实际，以预算清单为左侧连接，找不到实际值用 0。差额为实际减预算，超支标记要求实际超过预算的 110%。
teaching.resultExplanation: 差额为正意味着实际超过预算。实际有费用但完全无预算的科目不在此报告中，若需检查覆盖漏洞应另外做反连接；合计时不应把部门预算按明细重复累计。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 费用按会计科目和期间归集，先确认原交易是支出还是冲销。相同金额可能有不同收支方向，不能按绝对值把收入和支出一起加进实际费用。
月度预算分析要在两边都保留部门、科目及月份再连接，差额为实际减预算；年度汇总则先按一致粒度汇总。年度差额可抵消月份之间的波动。

knowledgePoints.title: 银行流水与凭证全量对账
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 在统一企业数据库中独立完成：银行流水与凭证全量对账
knowledgePoints.concept: 2025年费用凭证按真实reference_no汇总费用净额；银行按真实reference_no汇总净支出，净支出=-SUM(amount_cents)，正向冲回或收入作为负支出，不能逐行取ABS。采用两端全量键集合，每条NULL银行参考号单独对账，并用reference_kind区分reference与unreferenced_bank，防止合成显示名BANK-编号与真实参考号碰撞。返回有缺失或金额差异的记录，差额=银行净支出-账簿费用；缺失端输出NULL。显示ref为真实参考号或BANK-银行编号。按ref升序、reference_kind升序。
knowledgePoints.syntax:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT 0 unreferenced, reference_no ref, SUM(expense_cents) ledger
  FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no
), b AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unreferenced,
    COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR)) ref, SUM(-amount_cents) bank
  FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR))
), k AS (
  SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM a UNION SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM b
)
SELECT CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN CONCAT('BANK-',k.ref) ELSE k.ref END ref,
  a.ledger ledger_cents,b.bank bank_cents,COALESCE(b.bank,0)-COALESCE(a.ledger,0) difference_cents,
  CASE WHEN a.ref IS NULL THEN 'bank_only' WHEN b.ref IS NULL THEN 'ledger_only' ELSE 'difference' END issue,
  CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN 'unreferenced_bank' ELSE 'reference' END reference_kind
FROM k LEFT JOIN a ON a.ref=k.ref AND a.unreferenced=k.unreferenced
LEFT JOIN b ON b.ref=k.ref AND b.unreferenced=k.unreferenced
WHERE a.ref IS NULL OR b.ref IS NULL OR a.ledger<>b.bank ORDER BY ref,reference_kind

knowledgePoints.title: 多规则异常交易筛查
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 在统一企业数据库中独立完成：多规则异常交易筛查
knowledgePoints.concept: 截至2025-12-31的每张发票计算四个复核标记：同供应商同invoice_no存在多张发票；原始发票面额超过该供应商全部期间内发票面额均值的2倍；净应付减实付余额为负；原始发票面额与本张发票已开票数量按对应采购行单价重算金额相差超过100分。面额及采购重算金额均在本张发票行内汇总，不能使用整张采购单总收货金额，不冲减贷项；超额付款标记使用截止日已批准贷项后的净应付。数量是否超收或超开票由三方核对题检查，本题第四项专门识别开票价格差异。输出净应付billed_cents和四个标记，至少一个标记才返回，按标记数降序、发票编号升序。大额及价格标记使用未舍入值，标记只代表复核候选。
knowledgePoints.syntax:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT x.supplier_invoice_id,SUM(x.quantity_billed*x.unit_price_cents) face,
    SUM(x.quantity_billed*p.unit_price_cents) expected
  FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN purchase_order_items p ON p.po_item_id=x.po_item_id
  GROUP BY x.supplier_invoice_id
), a AS (
  SELECT v.*,f.face,f.expected,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id,invoice_no) copies,
    AVG(f.face) OVER(PARTITION BY supplier_id) avg_bill
  FROM v_invoice_balance v JOIN f ON f.supplier_invoice_id=v.supplier_invoice_id
), z AS (
  SELECT a.*,CASE WHEN copies>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END duplicate_flag,
    CASE WHEN face>2*avg_bill THEN 1 ELSE 0 END large_flag,
    CASE WHEN balance_cents<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END overpay_flag,
    CASE WHEN ABS(face-expected)>100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END mismatch_flag FROM a
)
SELECT supplier_invoice_id,supplier_id,billed_cents,duplicate_flag,large_flag,overpay_flag,mismatch_flag,
  duplicate_flag+large_flag+overpay_flag+mismatch_flag flags FROM z
WHERE duplicate_flag+large_flag+overpay_flag+mismatch_flag>0 ORDER BY flags DESC,supplier_invoice_id

mergedFrom.title: 人力资源：指定日期在职人数

teaching.problem: 人资需要比较部门规模变化与人员离职率，不能只用离职人数比较大部门及小部门。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先建立部门月份，依据任职有效期间分别求月初和月末人数、期间离职数，再按题设基数计算月度及滚动比率。

mergedConcepts.explanation: 指定日期的在职区间是入职日不晚于该日，且终止日为空或晚于该日。终止当天不在职，使同一份任职记录在连续日期上的状态一致。
期间离职率用真实离职事件数除以期初、期末平均在职人数。部门调离会影响两端人数，但调动不是企业离职，不能混入离职分子。
部门月末净变化可用本月月末人数减上月月末人数，任职历史按左闭右开区间匹配。要查看 2025 年 1 月变化，先保留 2024 年 12 月基线再过滤输出。

knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 在统一企业数据库中独立完成：采购价格与合同、历史价格比较
knowledgePoints.concept: 2025年非取消采购行；比较合同单价、成交价及同供应商同商品上一采购行的实际单价；上一行按订单日期、行编号；输出合同差价及较上一单变动率。

mergedFrom.title: 同商品跨供应商采购价差

teaching.problem: 采购经理需要同时发现偏离有效合同的价格，以及同一商品采购价的历史波动。
teaching.codeExplanation: 按供应商、商品匹配有效期合同；历史上一笔价格按业务日期与稳定编号排序，用 LAG 取上次，再计算差额和比率。
teaching.resultExplanation: 偏离合同与历史上涨是不同信号。跨供应商比较可先确认货品、规格、数量和交期一致。

checkpoints.name: a
checkpoints.label: 在采购行匹配合同并取历史上一笔价格
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT i.po_item_id,p.supplier_id,i.product_id,p.order_date,i.unit_price_cents,c.unit_price_cents contract_cents,LAG(i.unit_price_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY p.supplier_id,i.product_id ORDER BY p.order_date,i.po_item_id) previous_cents FROM purchase_order_items i JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE p.status<>'cancelled')
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 LIMIT 3;

mergedConcepts.explanation: 核对采购承诺成本时，用合规采购行的订购数量×约定单价，未批准或取消的订单按指标口径排除。实际收货金额和最终开票金额另用各自事件量计算。
跨供应商比价用同商品同供应商的总采购金额÷总订购量，不能直接平均各单价。只比较至少两家供应商的商品；相对最低价溢价以最低加权价为分母，分母为 0 时留空。

steps.label: 分别计算两种件数履约和质量指标

mergedFrom.title: 采购：交付延误与未到齐

teaching.problem: 供应商评价不能只看单一到货日，还需要完整履约和质量指标。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先按采购行累计各次收货、接收及拒收数量，再从到期采购行计算准时与完整率。质量率按数量口径，分母与行数指标不同。
teaching.resultExplanation: 晚到、到货不足和质量不合格可同时发生。将三类表现拆开，便于采购制定不同补救措施。

checkpoints.name: due_line_flags
checkpoints.label: 为到期采购行标记准时及到齐
checkpoints.sql:
SELECT po_item_id,supplier_id,quantity_ordered,received,accepted,
 CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ontime_flag,
 CASE WHEN accepted>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS complete_flag
FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 LIMIT 3;

checkpoints.name: supplier_totals
checkpoints.label: 按供应商累计行数、收货及接收数量
checkpoints.sql:
SELECT supplier_id,COUNT(*) AS due_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ontime_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN accepted>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS complete_lines,
 SUM(accepted) AS accepted_units,SUM(received) AS received_units
FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY supplier_id ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 LIMIT 3;

mergedConcepts.explanation: 一条订购行可以分批收货。先按采购行累计接收量，再与订购量比较；无收货的采购行仍应保留，累计量为 0。
准时履约按已到承诺日的有效采购行计数，分子是承诺日（含当日）之前累计达到订购量的采购行，第一批到货的日期不能代表全部到齐。
按收货日期累计数量，第一次达到订购量的日期才是到齐日。未到齐用缺失到齐日单列；已经超过承诺日时，以分析截止日衡量逾期天数。

knowledgePoints.title: 采购、收货、发票三方核对
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 在统一企业数据库中独立完成：采购、收货、发票三方核对
knowledgePoints.concept: 2025年非取消采购行（截止年底）；输出订购、合格收货、开票数量，开票金额与合格收货按采购单价的金额差；仅数量不等或金额差不为0；未开票也需要呈现。 本题核对原始开票行，不冲减后续贷项；净应付与贷项的核对见财务题。
knowledgePoints.syntax:
WITH billed AS (
  SELECT x.po_item_id,SUM(x.quantity_billed) billed,SUM(x.quantity_billed*x.unit_price_cents) billed_cents
  FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN supplier_invoices f ON f.supplier_invoice_id=x.supplier_invoice_id
  WHERE f.invoice_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY x.po_item_id
